kind: engineering diagnostic (NOT a scientific experiment); re-attempt of the same authorized diagnostic after a harness defect

authority.quote: 你可以在新独占登记中先做一次 CPU-only、无发布的完整 8+2 秒工程诊断，无需再问我；执行前须统一 P1→P2 的明确准入规则，核实当前源码身份、本人进程及目标 CPU 核负载，重新测可用 RAM，并在导入 JAX 前锁定 CPU 环境。GPU 仍繁忙时不启动任何 GPU 依赖阶段。诊断要保留超时、退出和回收原件；它通过后，再登记可发布请求，不把诊断补写成 PASS。
why_a_second_attempt_is_the_same_authori: r1 never reached the timed 8 s segment, so no measurement of the declared diagnostic exists yet.
r1 stopped on a defect in my own harness (the closure candidate crashed on the real module set), not on a resource, scientific or protocol condition.
the user explicitly required the diagnostic to keep its timeout / exit / reap originals, which presupposes that aborted attempts are preserved rather than silently repaired.
r1 is preserved byte-intact; nothing from r1 is reused as measurement, and r1 is not rewritten into a PASS.

preserved_predecessor_failure.cause: TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not _OpNamespace, raised in tools/actual_loaded_closure_candidate_r20.py:42 (_real_file(module.__cached__)) during the P1 capture
preserved_predecessor_failure.status: FAIL, preserved, not to be edited

defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.defect: closure candidate r20 assumed module.__file__ / module.__cached__ are path-like when truthy; a module in the real maskco import stack fabricates attributes via a module-level __getattr__, so the deployed closure gate crashed on the real module set
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.fix: tools/actual_loaded_closure_candidate_r21.py: _real_file accepts only str/bytes/os.PathLike; captures record EVERY loaded module name mapped to its file or None
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.extra_strength: r20 only recorded modules that had a file, so a file-less module appearing during a timed region was invisible; r21 detects it (verified locally, scenario E)
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.local_verification: local_unified_protocol_v2_test.py -> LOCAL_UNIFIED_PROTOCOL_v2_RESULT.json: 9 pass / 0 fail, including the exact r1 crash input

defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.defect: the owned-leftover precondition counted the supervisor's own bash -c ancestor as a leftover process, so the gate was false in r1 and the pass rule would have been unreachable
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.fix: server_diagnostic_r2.py excludes the process ancestry (and any own diagnostic process), and records every exclusion by pid + cmdline for audit; ancestor_pids is written into the output
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.note: this is the same class of value that the delivery registration left as owned_leftovers_checked=false; r2 produces a verified boolean with its exclusion list

defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.defect: the state file was only flushed after the P1 capture, so the r1 warm-up evidence (model load seconds, jax devices/backend) was lost when the crash happened
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.fix: server_diagnostic_r2.py flushes DIAG_STATE.json after every phase, including after the warm-up and before the P1 capture

defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.observation: jax logs a non-fatal ERROR from the CUDA plugin during discovery (CUDA_ERROR_NO_DEVICE) even though CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' and JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu; r2 records the captured log records and asserts jax.devices() contains only CPU devices
defects_found_by_r1_and_their_fixes.fix: no code change; recorded as evidence under warmup.log_records

exclusive_namespace.rule: no other run may write into run_r1/ or run_r2/; existing FAIL artifacts elsewhere are read-only

admission_rule_p1_to_p2: P1 and P2 must be identical in file hashes, module-name->file map (including file-less module names), native path set and explicit path set; any change, addition, removal or remapping rejects. P0->P1 is informational because the declared warm-up exists to provoke lazy loading.

declared_unit_of_work.definition: one model chain = encode_cvrp(51 nodes, B=1) followed by decode_edge_logits
declared_unit_of_work.explicitly_not: the complete delivery request; the request-level closure gate remains unqualified by this diagnostic

timed_execution.rule: repeat the declared unit until the 8.0 s budget is reached; per-unit times recorded

recovery_reserve.rule: declared as gc.collect() + release of timed-region temporaries, measured; must be <= 2.0 s

segments.closure_captures: outside the request budget; capture seconds are recorded as an observation and are NOT used to satisfy the 8 s budget

preconditions_and_gates.cpu_environment_locked: sched_setaffinity to core 15 AND JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu AND CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' AND all *_NUM_THREADS=1, set BEFORE importing jax
preconditions_and_gates.available_ram_gate: >= 8.0 GiB available, measured in-process before any heavy import
preconditions_and_gates.no_owned_leftover_processes: no process owned by the login user running python, after excluding the diagnostic's own process ancestry (exclusions listed by pid)
preconditions_and_gates.cpu_only_no_gpu_device: jax.devices() contains only CPU devices and jax.default_backend() == 'cpu'
preconditions_and_gates.registration_hash_recorded: sha256 of this file recorded inside the run output
preconditions_and_gates.model_loaded: cvrp100.ckpt loaded and the declared unit produced finite logits

pass_rule: gate_pass = true iff every gate in preconditions_and_gates passes; the verdict is computed by the executor process and written into run_r2/DIAG_STATE.json
failure_handling: a raised exception writes DIAG_FAILURE.json + DIAG_FAILURE.traceback.txt and exits 2
an unmet gate writes DIAG_STATE.json with gate_pass=false and exits 1
either outcome is final for this attempt and must not be edited; a further re-attempt requires a new attempt_id
no publication is performed on any outcome
prohibited_in_this_attempt: GPU use or any GPU-dependent stage
editing run_r1 or any other previous FAIL artifact
post-hoc rewriting of the diagnostic verdict
treating this diagnostic as evidence about utility or about any scientific effect
non_claims: does not qualify a publishable delivery request
does not establish or refute any online gain
measures a model-level unit, not the complete request
